Ca binet Sec r eta ri at File No.P-31032/7/2020-CEMENT File No: P-34 � 0 32 /7 /2020 -C ement Government of India Ministry of Commerce & Industry Department for Promotion of Industry & Internal Trade (Cement Section) ORDER Udyog Bhawan, New Delhi Dated the 13 May, 2020 Subject: Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India), Order 20 1 7-notifying Cement in furtherance of the Order. The Government of India has issued Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India), Order 2017 vide the Department for Promotion of Industry & Internal Trade (DPilT) Notification no. P-45021/2/2017-B.E.-II dated 15.06.2017(as amended on 29/05/2019)to encourage 'Make in India' and to promote manufacturing and production of goods and services in India with a view to enhancing income and employment. 2. In reference to clause 3(a) of Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India), Order 2017 (last amended on 29/05/2019), it is hereby notified that there exists sufficient local capacity and local competition in respect of following types of cement and only local suppliers shall be eligible to bid for all public procurement irrespective of purchase value: I SI. No. Iype of Cement I Ordinary Portland Cement 2 Portland Slag Cement 3 Portland Pozzolona Cement (Flyash based) 4 Composite Cement 5 Oil Well Cement 3. This Order shall come into effect immediately. Relevant BIS Standard IS 269:2015 IS 455:2015 IS 1489(Partl ): 2015 IS 16415:2015 IS 8229:2015 4. DPllT shall be the Nodal Ministry to monitor the implementation of Order on Cement.
